pins.requirement: ACTIVE HIGH shutdown: high (supply voltage) = amp off, 4.2 uA; 0 V = amp on. Must be a defined level (not floating). Datasheet app circuit: pull-up RPU to VDD plus switch to GND
pins.cite: FM8002A datasheet (Fuman, Version 1.0, LCSC C94625; same text in ChipSourceTek Version 1.1) p.1 pin table; p.2 '关断功能' (Shutdown function); p.6 typical application
pins.quote: 当关断端为高电平（电源电压）时，运放关闭，FM8002A 不工作，这时 FM8002A 的工作电流降低到 4.2uA；当关断端为零电平时运放打开 [When SHUTDOWN is high (supply voltage) the amp is off, current 4.2 uA; when SHUTDOWN is at zero level the amp is on]
pins.issue: Polarity CONFIRMED in both datasheet copies: R36 100k to VSYS (=VDD) keeps the amp off; Q3 (2N7002, gate AMP_EN with R37 pull-down) pulls SHUTDOWN to 0 V = on. Matches the datasheet's own RPU + switch-to-GND circuit. No VIH/VIL thresholds are given (only 'supply voltage' / 'zero level'): unknown, but the design drives rail-to-rail so it does not matter. Datasheet wake-up time TD = 100 ms typ.
